decisions: InterproceduralAnalysisContext is created per Roslyn Compilation and owns its own template cache; no static or cross-compilation cache is used.
Template cache keys normalize to method OriginalDefinition through a SymbolEqualityComparer-based MethodSymbolKey so overloads and constructed generic calls keep semantic identity.
Cached values are MethodComplexityTemplate results relative to callee parameters only; caller argument binding and substitution remain pending.
The cache uses ConcurrentDictionary entries with explicit InProgress and Completed states instead of Lazy<T>, so future cycle handling does not need self-waiting cache initialization.

AnalysisBudget remains internal with MaximumCallDepth = 5 and MaximumMethodsPerRootAnalysis = 32; InterproceduralRootAnalysisState owns depth, expanded method count, active path, and CancellationToken per root.

Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, MathNet, or SymPy.

Keep analyzer hot paths deterministic, cancellation-aware, concurrency-safe, and free from I/O, network access, process execution, and reflection-heavy behavior.
